findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current V152 images shows that the narrower recessed valley and stronger crease profile do not make a clearly readable pleat rhythm at product scale. Front and back still read as broad smooth/faceted flared panels, with a rigid apron-like center/side transition and hard hem; the 40 mm relief is visible only as weak panel shading.

Crouch and sit still expose oversized hard-edged shorts/thigh-cover panels while the skirt lifts away behind the thighs. Current pose-matched coverage is overskirt left/right 0.365/0.365 in crouch and 0.272/0.270 in sit; shorts cover 0.642 per side in crouch and 0.638 per side in sit. These geometric diagnostics do not establish fit.

Angular triangular surface patches and abrupt transitions remain visible across the torso/waist in front, three-quarter, side and arm-cross views. The prone view continues to collapse garment and limbs into a compact overlapping pile; appearance and pose behavior remain unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. The V152 crease-profile change still does not yield legible garment pleats, so do not repeat profile-parameter tuning. Replace the current radial displacement-only fold field with authored crease topology or a panel-shaped construction that creates visible fold planes while preserving sewn seam boundaries and armature deformation. In the same next iteration, prioritize a shorter/cut-back thigh shell to resolve crouch/sit exposure and remove the visible torso/waist facets; prone remains a required pose blocker. Rebuild and directly inspect all eleven poses. Fit, UV, material, Shape Key, Unity, VRChat, package and release remain unverified.
